[{"type":"GeneralText","content":"

The following are the LOWER DIVISION REQUIREMENTS for this major.

Please visit the catalog for all requirements for Public Policy, B.A.


Majors shall develop a public policy concentration in consultation with the advisor. The concentration shall reflect substantial depth in a single area of public policy analysis. Concentrations must consist of a minimum of 3 courses/12 units at the 200 level or higher (no more than two courses at the 200 level). The courses in your concentration should be drawn across multiple departments and no more than 2 courses can be drawn from any single alpha (i.e., at least two programs of study or departments must be represented, and this includes transferred courses or study away courses).
